overview: Krechet Academy is an interactive educational platform and marketing growth simulator designed to train marketers and agency professionals through structured playbooks, hands-on calculators, and AI-assisted workflows.

keyFeatures.title: Action Plan Curriculum & Milestone Dashboard
keyFeatures.editOrActionTrigger: Click 'Start Lesson' on any chapter card or select 'Start Day 1 (Lesson 1.1)' from the top banner
keyFeatures.description: Displays sequential chapters organized by daily progression ('Learn', 'See & AI Assist', and 'Do'). Each card showcases estimated completion times, skill tags (such as Unit Economics, Break-Even CPA, and Client Discovery), and progress tracking indicators.

keyFeatures.title: Interactive Break-Even CPA Calculator Simulation
keyFeatures.editOrActionTrigger: Click the blue 'Start Lesson' button on Chapter 1.6 card
keyFeatures.description: A hands-on practical simulation module where learners calculate unit economics, profit margins, and target ROAS using real-world business scenarios.

keyFeatures.title: Client Inquiry & Rapport Simulation Portal
keyFeatures.description: A scenario-based interactive chat and messaging simulation where students practice communicating with client personas like Jenny Miller to build rapport and conduct discovery.

keyFeatures.title: Marketing Lab & Playbook Navigation
keyFeatures.editOrActionTrigger: Click 'A/B Testing Lab' or 'Agency Playbooks' in the left drawer
keyFeatures.description: Quick-access drawer for core agency tools, specialized testing environments, account settings, and subscription management.

keyFeatures.title: Multimodal Learning & Havoc Crisis Calls
keyFeatures.editOrActionTrigger: Experience multiple-choice knowledge checkpoints, conversational listening, and surprise havoc crisis calls
keyFeatures.description: Students learn through multiple-choice questions, conversation, listening, and simulation. The curriculum throws curveballs through havoc calls to ensure students are always prepared for unexpected real-world agency crises.

keyFeatures.title: Interview Defense Prep & Day-1 Job Readiness
keyFeatures.editOrActionTrigger: Practice articulating, portraying, and defending campaign choices in live interview simulations
keyFeatures.description: Students learn to speak, portray, and defend their marketing decisions based on the campaigns they built, establishing a strong foundation so they are 100% ready for Day 1 in the professional marketing world.

suggestedStoryline.title: The Hook
suggestedStoryline.voiceoverGoal: Highlight the challenge modern marketers face when moving from theoretical marketing concepts to real agency-level execution.
suggestedStoryline.visualAction: Show the Krechet Academy dashboard displaying structured daily roadmaps and interactive simulation chapters.

suggestedStoryline.title: Interactive Execution
suggestedStoryline.voiceoverGoal: Demonstrate how students transition seamlessly from learning theory to AI-assisted practice and hands-on calculations.
suggestedStoryline.visualAction: Click 'Start Lesson' on an interactive module like Chapter 1.6 (Interactive Break-Even CPA Calculator) or Chapter 1.9 (Client Inquiry Portal) to launch the simulation workbench.
